Geometry-derived analysis shows one V orbit with 5 geometric neighbors (4 S, 1 V; 2.34–2.49 Å) and another V orbit with 6 S neighbors at 2.43 Å, while the 2 S orbit has 7 neighbors (5 V, 2 S). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between 7-vertex S and 5-vertex V coordination polyhedra.
